title: Design rule-record readiness disposition layer
description: Implement the architecture recommended by docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-8-rule-classification.md (§3): a fail-closed disposition layer for rule records (mirroring GAMEPLAY_READINESS_DISPOSITIONS) classifying each of the 335 rules as engine-procedure / reference-prose / definition / table-backed / duplicate(canonical-owner), with exact reviewed memberships from the artifact's master matrix. Readiness output must distinguish acceptable prose from actionable gaps. Do NOT project engine procedures as per-record mechanics.effects — the artifact's key finding is that PROC rules are engine procedures, not record payloads. Recommended agent: Opus 4.8 for the layer shape; Codex for membership rollout from the artifact.
notes:
Corrected inputs (2026-07-06, commit 068bff3): census PROC 175/REF 96/DEF 33/TABLE 19/DUP 12; 13 families; primary-disposition rule = PROC dominates hybrids. Layer MUST separate semantic disposition from implementation coverage (implemented-with-evidence / partial / unimplemented / design-blocked) — engine-procedure is never blanket-green; new/promoted rules fail closed. Support canonical-owner pointers (12 DUPs), table-backed evidence, and cross-bead ownership (18.7.6 gear payloads).

Remaining work on this bead = implementation per design §7 (Codex).
